chapter: Booker T. Washington Community Center Band
title: Moving up to trumpet as older players leave
summary: After about two years on alto horn, first-chair Matthew Holland left to play with adult bands; chairs shifted up and Jones was given fourth trumpet and quickly rose to first chair.

bands.name: Booker T. Washington Community Center Band

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Yeah, sure. Well, when you switched to trumpet, you were like about two years on the alto?

Yeah, about two years on the alto, and some the guys left. There was a guy named Matthew Holland, he was the first chair man, and he studied very hard at home on his horn, and finally he went out and started playing with the adults around town, you know.
Yeah.
He started to play with them.
What was he, 17 or 18 or something?
Yeah, just about.
Yeah.
And she wasn't too keen on you playing with outsiders like that, you know.
Oh.
Because she'd try to keep you, you know, keep you away from whiskey, and didn't want you to be mixed up in that crowd out there.
Yeah.
And stuff. So he left and he went with a band that was called Howard Jordan's, I think, and then that means that somebody else that was sitting next to him, they'd move up into his chair, you know.
Right.

And then when they'd go, somebody'd move up. So then they come to me once and said, 'Well, we're going to put you on the trumpet, fourth trumpet.' So I was playing -- had about two of us playing fourth trumpet, and about, oh, maybe two or three playing third trumpet and about two or three playing second trumpet. Then you had the first trumpet, one guy played that, then you had a solo trumpet. Some of them overtures had on there, 'Solo trumpet,' you know.
Oh, yeah.
Or, 'First trumpet,' you know. And so it didn't take me long at all to move up to the first chair, because the other guys was leaving.
Well, Jonah, was that -- can you remember was that a thrill when you picked up that trumpet, after the alto horn?
Yeah, well I was glad to get it. I was
glad to get a trumpet so I could play some melody, you know.
Yeah.
I was glad to get it.
